Question: Meri mangni mujh se do saal badi meri cousin se hui hai kya shariyat ke lihaz se umar me bade ladki se shaadi karna jayaz hai? Answer ID: 6463 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 603/603=M/1429) It is allowed to marry a girl elder than you.
